51577277.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to MDM2 (unknown origin) by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR: The interaction of compound V9 and V10 with MDM2 protein was detected by molecular interaction analyzer (PALL FORTEBIO, USA). MDM2 protein (50 μg/mL, Profinitech) was immobilized on a PCH sensor chip (Octet) and pre-activated for 600 s using an EDC/NHS mixture at a flow rate of 10 μL/min. Dilute V9 or V10 to 0, 3.13, 6.25, 12.5, 25, 50, 100 μM with PBST buffers containing 5% DMSO and 0.005% Tween. The binding time was 400 s, and the flow rate was 15 μL/min. The dissociation time was 60 s, and the affinity constant K_D value was obtained by computer fitting and steady-state analysis.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Fig. 5. Affinity detection of V9 and MDM2. (A). Molecular docking results of MDM2 (PDB ID: 4j3e) with V9. (B). The binding affinity of MDM2 protein to V9 was determined by SPR.
original_paragraph.Figure 6 caption: Fig. 6. Affinity detection of V10 and MDM2. (A). Molecular docking results of MDM2 (PDB ID: 4j3e) with V10. (B). The binding affinity of MDM2 protein to V10 was determined by SPR. (C) The effect of V10 on the stability of MDM2 was detected by CETSA assay.
original_paragraph.Figure 5B sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 5B shows response (RU) over time (s) for V9 at concentrations of 100μM, 50μM, 25μM, 12.5μM, 6.25μM, and 3.13μM. The binding affinity (K_D) is reported as 32.4±0.2 μM.
original_paragraph.Figure 6B sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 6B shows response (RU) over time (s) for V10 at concentrations of 100μM, 50μM, 25μM, 12.5μM, 6.25μM, and 3.13μM. The binding affinity (K_D) is reported as 38.2±0.1 μM.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: PBST buffers containing 5% DMSO and 0.005% Tween
